title: TailObliviousMonotoneRootFinding.lean

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained monotone operator root finding: F:E→E is globally L-Lipschitz and monotone, with F(x*)=0 and ‖x0−x*‖≤R. No objective or gradient representation is assumed. L>0 and R≥0.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Stochastic operator evaluations g(x,ξ) with independent identically distributed fresh seeds, E[g(x,ξ)]=F(x), and uniformly bounded central α-th moment. Each sampled evaluation counts as one oracle call; no sample reuse interface is supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/TailObliviousMonotoneRootFinding.lean: HeavyTailedOperator and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: E‖g(x,ξ)−F(x)‖^α≤σ^α for every x, with 1<α≤2 and σ≥0. Variance need not be finite when α<2.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; no dimension bound or bounded feasible domain is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Only E, x0, and L are public. The algorithm cannot depend on α, σ, R, or ε, although the external fixed oracle budget depends on them.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation is over both algorithm randomness and the IID oracle seed sequence, after execution with the supplied fixed oracle budget.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: The output X must be measurable, ‖F(X)‖^α integrable, and E‖F(X)‖^α≤ε^α for ε>0. This is an operator residual moment criterion, not an objective gap or variational inequality gap.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Monotone Lipschitz root finding is classical, but this formulation combines potentially infinite-variance noise, an α-th residual moment guarantee, and an algorithm unaware of the moment order, noise scale, initial radius, and target accuracy.

descriptionHtml:
Tail-Oblivious Monotone Root Finding

We seek a zero of a monotone, L-Lipschitz operator F:E→E on a finite-dimensional real inner product space E, where L>0. A given point x0∈E lies within distance R≥0 of a zero x⋆. The oracle returns an unbiased random vector estimating F(x) at each query x, using independent, identically distributed samples, with centered α-moment at most σα, where 1<α≤2 and σ≥0. The algorithm knows only E, x0, and L. For ε>0, the goal is a measurable output x¯∈E satisfying EP∥F(x¯)∥α≤εα, where P is the joint law of independent algorithm and oracle randomness.

The root-finding problem is find x∈E such that F(x)=0. Write ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ for the inner product and ∥⋅∥ for its induced norm. The parameters α, σ, R, and ε may enter the oracle-call budget, but are not algorithm inputs.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Monotonicity and Lipschitz continuity). For all x,y∈E, ⟨F(x)−F(y),x−y⟩≥0,∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥.

Assumption 2 (Nearby zero). There exists x⋆∈E such that F(x⋆)=0,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Assumption 3 (Heavy-tailed stochastic oracle). Let Ω be a measurable sample space and ν a probability measure on Ω. There is a jointly measurable map g:E×Ω→E. For every x∈E, the map g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable and ∥g(x,⋅)−F(x)∥α is integrable under ν, with Eξ∼ν[g(x,ξ)]=F(x),Eξ∼ν[∥g(x,ξ)−F(x)∥α]≤σα. At call k≥0, a query xk∈E receives g(xk,ξk), where the measurable sample variables (ξk)k≥0 are mutually independent and each has law ν. The sample sequence is independent of the algorithm’s randomness.

Queries may be made at any point of E. After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯ must be measurable, its residual moment ∥F(x¯)∥α must be integrable under P, and it must satisfy EP[∥F(x¯)∥α]≤εα.

comparisonHtml:
A finite-dimensional real inner-product space; a monotone, globally L-Lipschitz operator F, L>0, with F(x⋆)=0 and ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R. IID samples have law p and joint law P. The jointly measurable oracle g is integrable, ∫g(x,ω)dp=F(x), and its integrable central moment satisfies ∫∥g(x,ω)−F(x)∥αdp≤σα, 1<α≤2, R,σ≥0. Target: ∫∥F(Z)∥αdP≤εα, ε>0, for the constructed method’s last completed epoch Z. Only x0,L are public inputs; the stopping budget depends on α,σ,R,ε.

Monotone root finding with tail-oblivious updates: TailObliviousMonotoneRootFinding.

Updates need no α,σ,R,ε; stopping still does. At α=2, matches polynomial rate and strengthens residual to second moment. (1) at α=2: deterministic factor ℓ2 instead of 1+log⁡h; noise factor ℓ4 instead of h3.
(3) Clipped-SEG (Sadiev et al. 2023), Thm. G.2 O(1+LR2δlog(e+LR2δβ)+(σRδ)blog(e+σRδβ)) for P{GapR(x¯)≤δ}≥1−β. (1): No clipping or α,σ,R,ε in updates. Certifies residual instead of restricted gap; rates are not comparable. (1): Expectation only; needs global assumptions instead of assumptions on B4R(x⋆). No proved bound on ∥Z−x⋆∥ converts its residual guarantee to this gap.

Abbr: Costs count individual stochastic operator calls, including all stages and batches. b=α/(α−1); ℓ=1+log⁡(1+LR/ε+σ/ε); h=1+log⁡(1+LR/ε). δ>0 is gap accuracy, 0<β<1 is failure probability, x¯ is the averaged extragradient point, and GapR(x)=sup∥y−x⋆∥≤R⟨F(y),x−y⟩.

import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.TailObliviousMonotoneRootFinding

open OracleTemplate

structure HeavyTailedOperator {E Ω : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (p : Measure Ω) (F : E → E) (g : E → Ω → E) (σ α : ℝ) : Prop where
  measurable : Measurable (Function.uncurry g)
  integrable : ∀ x, Integrable (g x) p
  unbiased : ∀ x, (∫ ω, g x ω ∂p) = F x
  moment_integrable : ∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - F x‖ ^ α) p
  moment : ∀ x, (∫ ω, ‖g x ω - F x‖ ^ α ∂p) ≤ σ ^ α

structure Public where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [innerE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  x0 : E
  L : ℝ

attribute [instance] Public.normedE Public.innerE Public.finiteE Public.measurableE
  Public.borelE

structure Params extends Public where
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  α : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

attribute [instance] Params.measurableΩ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance q := q.E → q.E
  Query q := q.E
  Reply q := q.E
  Output q := q.E
  publicInput q := q.toPublic
  valid q := 0 < q.L ∧ 1 < q.α ∧ q.α ≤ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 0 ≤ q.R ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q F O :=
    ∃ (g : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) (p : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω)
      (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
    LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID
      (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (p : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, x) seed => g x seed } ∧
    (∀ x y, 0 ≤ inner ℝ (F x - F y) (x - y)) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ q.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar, F xstar = 0 ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R) ∧
    HeavyTailedOperator (p : Measure _) F g q.σ q.α
  successful q F output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => ‖F (output ω)‖ ^ q.α) (P : Measure _) ∧
    (∫ ω, ‖F (output ω)‖ ^ q.α ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ q.ε ^ q.α

end LongTails.Setups.TailObliviousMonotoneRootFinding
